newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds steady, some action at long end.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds steady, some action at long end.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Austrian bonds moved sideways on Thursday in what traders described as quiet pre-holiday trading, with some customer interest noted at the longer end.
"It's not really sticking out, but still surprising for this time of the year," said one market participant.
* Latest 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 20 bps at 99.70 to yield 5. 91 (5.94) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.68/78 to yield 5.91/5.90.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 up five bps at 103.05 to yield 4.73 (4.74) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 103.20/103.30 to yield 4.69/67 percent.
* AGB future up four bps at 106.26 on turnover of 855 lots.
* 10-year spread to German bunds up two at eight bps, five-year spread down three at 16 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.350 and overnight money higher at 3.01/3.26. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
